none: PAS NLM-68A953: Roman Coin: Quarter of a Denarius of Caracalla
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ (---)NVS PIVS AVG G(---) ; R/ V(ENVS VICTRI)X

Silver. Coin. Quarter of Denarius of Caracalla (198-217), issue of 213-217, Reece period 11. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: (---)NVS PIVS AVG G(---). Reverse description: Venus left (holding Victory and sceptre) resting on shield set on helmet. Reverse inscription: V(ENVS VICTRI)X. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this fragmentary coin, citing Sear volume 2 page 527 no. 6890; RIC 311b. Diameter (in excess of): 14mm, Weight: 0.93gms, die axis possibly 6
